prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beDelivery promotion poster with a cloudy pale sky background and soft glow. At the top left, add stacked dark text 'Chào đón thứ 6 Giao hàng'. Below it place large gradient blue text 'Giảm 50%'. Add black text 'Nhập mã' followed by a yellow rounded label reading 'T6BAORE'. On the right, place a giant cream-and-yellow hanging tag labeled 'THỨ 6', and have an illustrated be rider mascot step out from the tag while lifting a cardboard parcel with a blue be logo. Add a smaller floating cardboard box on the left and the blue beDelivery wordmark at the bottom left. Technical style: illustrated delivery promotional poster with soft glow composite, airy cloud ambience, bright playful campaign energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
